name: B10-0138/2024 (ECR) – People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
title: People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on China and Taiwan. It says China misuses a 1971 United Nations resolution to claim Taiwan as its own. It condemns China's military drills around Taiwan and asks the European Union to support Taiwan's participation in international bodies, to deepen trade talks with Taiwan, and to rename its office in Taiwan.

- The European Union is asked to back Taiwan's role in world bodies and start trade talks.
- Taiwan and China are affected; the European Union's offices and trade policy would change.
- The European Union's member states and its executive must now respond to these requests.
